Title: Now Available: Azure Databricks is generally available in China North 3

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks is a data analytics service available as a first-party Azure service. Azure Databricks offers three environments for developing data intensive applications: Databricks SQL, Databricks Data Science & Engineering, and Databricks Machine Learning.

Azure Databricks is now generally available in China North 3. For more information about Azure Databricks, please check out Azure Databricks documentation.
